name: describe_hand
description: Read joint names, limits, axes and basic kinematics once; subsequent calls do not repeat metadata. Returns structured JSON; display the entire returned value with text(result) in the native code transport.

name: get_state
description: Read compact canonical joint positions, contact/load, object drift and collision/safety state. Does not advance simulation. Returns structured JSON; display the entire returned value with text(result) in the native code transport.

name: set_joint_targets
description: Set any number of indexed joint targets in radians together and run the existing finite-effort position servos for duration seconds. Unspecified joints retain prior targets. No IK, contact advance or contact-triggered stopping. Returns current compact state at the action boundary. Returns structured JSON; display the entire returned value with text(result) in the native code transport.

name: stop
description: Hold the measured posture using the existing low-level API; return current compact state. Returns structured JSON; display the entire returned value with text(result) in the native code transport.
